issues.title: Single-letter variable names in SSH helper (c, s, s1, s2)
issues.fix: Rename single-letter locals to descriptive names. In cmdStatus and cmdSwitch, use 'conn' instead of 'c' and 'status' / 'status1' / 'status2' instead of 's' / 's1' / 's2'. This keeps intent visible at a glance.

issues.title: Single-letter variable 't' in loadSecrets
issues.fix: Rename 't' to 'trimmedLine' (or 'line' after reassignment) to make the loop body self-documenting.

issues.title: Single-letter variable 'r' in setTimeout promise wrapper
issues.convention: Parameter naming — clearly named and consistent
issues.fix: Rename the executor parameter 'r' to 'resolve' so the intent of the Promise constructor is immediately clear.

patterns.pattern: Command functions use 'cmd' prefix (cmdStatus, cmdSwitch, cmdConfigureIngress)
patterns.assessment: Consistent and clear — follows the verb-prefix convention well for CLI entry points.
Good verb-prefix naming, clearly communicates intent.

patterns.pattern: Helper functions use verb prefix: loadSecrets, parseCertPem, parseTunnelToken, getStatus, start, stop, run, sshConnect
patterns.assessment: Mostly consistent. 'start' and 'stop' are slightly generic but acceptable in this narrow domain context (they always operate on cloudflared).
patterns.recommendation: No change needed — KISS applies; renaming to 'startCloudflared' would be over-specification.

patterns.pattern: Module-level constants use SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE (LOCAL_HOST, LOCAL_USER, GCP_HOST, etc.)
patterns.assessment: Correctly follows the rule for exported/global constants.
